title: 재벌 2세?
scene: 태오가 데뷔 후 처음 받은 정산으로 학습자에게 저녁을 산다. 레스토랑이 너무 비싸다

turns.speaker: B
turns.ko: 오늘 내가 낼게. 데뷔하고 첫 정산 들어왔어.
turns.rd: oneul naega naelge. debwihago cheot jeongsan deureowasseo.
turns.en: Today's on me. My first payout since debut just came in.

turns.speaker: A
turns.ko: 헐, 축하해! 근데 여기 메뉴 보고 좀 떨린다.
turns.rd: heol, chukahae! geunde yeogi menyu bogo jom tteollinda.
turns.en: Whoa, congrats! But looking at the menu, I'm kinda nervous.

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: It's fine. Just pretend you're a chaebol heir and order whatever.

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: One steak is 300,000 won. For real?

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Wait a sec. How much was my payout.

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Lolol let's get up. Let's go eat tteokbokki.

turns.speaker: C
turns.ko: 물은 무료예요~ 근데 주문하신 샴페인 타워 지금 나오고 있어요.
turns.rd: mureun muryoyeyo~ geunde jumunhasin syampein tawo jigeum naogo isseoyo.
turns.en: Water's free~ But the champagne tower you ordered is coming out now.

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: What? We didn't order that. Wait a sec!

turns.speaker: A
turns.ko: 헐 이거 어떻게 해. 일어나, 떡볶이는 내가 쏠게.
turns.rd: heol igeo eotteoke hae. ireona, tteokbokkineun naega ssolge.
turns.en: Whoa what do we do. Get up, tteokbokki's on me.

turns.speaker: B
turns.ko: 다음에 진짜 돈 생기면 여기 다시 오자. 그때는 내가...
turns.rd: daeume jinjja don saenggimyeon yeogi dasi oja. geuttaeneun naega...
turns.en: Next time when I actually have money, let's come back. Then I'll...
